name: Natto-Jiru (Natto Soup With Miso, Tofu, and Vegetables)

ingredients.name: mushrooms, such as shiitake, shimeji, or enoki
mixed vegetables, such as carrot, daikon, and lotus root

instructions.primary_message: Prepare mushrooms (this will vary depending on the type): wash away any dirt, discard tough stems, slice shiitake caps and any other large mushroom caps, and separate mushroom clusters into manageable groups. Meanwhile, in a medium saucepan, bring dashi to a simmer over medium-high heat. Add vegetables and mushrooms, cover, and reduce heat to medium-low. Simmer until tender, 8 to 10 minutes. Uncover, stir in wakame, and remove soup from heat.
In a suribachi (or mortar and pestle), grind natto into a paste that is mostly smooth and very sticky; alternatively, place in a small bowl and mash with a fork.

In a small bowl, combine mixed miso (or brown rice miso) and sweet white miso and whisk in 3 tablespoons hot dashi broth until smooth and free of lumps, then stir miso into soup until well combined. Whisk 2 tablespoons hot dashi broth into natto paste to loosen, then stir into soup. Gently stir in cubed tofu.

schema_metadata.keywords: fermentation, miso, natto, Seriously Asian, soups, soybeans

description: In this recipe for natto miso soup, the bitter tang of natto complements both brown miso and lighter, sweeter miso.
notes:
Optional or for serving: Sliced scallions, for garnish

Optional substitutions: chogo/awase miso → brown rice miso; silken tofu → medium tofu or firm tofu
author: Chichi Wang
